remarks: Welcome to River's Edge, Stamford's most desirable townhome community. This 2007 built end-unit townhouse offers 1,925 sq ft of thoughtfully designed living space across three levels. The main floor features a functional kitchen, w/ stainless steel appliances, complete with a spacious living area, dining area and sunny balcony. Upstairs, the primary suite is a true retreat with vaulted ceilings, generous closet space, and an ensuite primary bathroom. A second bedroom and full bath complete this level. The versatile third-level loft, with tall ceilings, provides endless possibilities-ideal as a home office, guest space, or play room.Additional highlights include central air, a dedicated laundry and storage room, and an attached one-car garage for added convenience. Residents of River's Edge enjoy access to desirable community amenities such as a heated in-ground pool, fitness center, and modern clubhouse - all included under the $320 /mo HOA fee. Conveniently situated in the heart of Springdale, this home is just minutes from the Springdale train station, Merritt Parkway, Darien, restaurants, shops, and all that Stamford has to offer. This unit also has a 3% assumable mortgage meaning you can assume the seller's current mortgage if you qualify.
